description: MemoryBackend::send_mdns has a for_email_id.is_none() check at the top of the entry loop that inserts a notFound SetError and continues. But handle_mdn_send filters out all None for_email_id entries (returning invalidProperties) before calling send_mdns. The backend check is unreachable via the handler and represents dead code that will confuse future contributors reading the backend. Wrong error type too (NotFound instead of InvalidProperties). Fix: remove the None check from MemoryBackend::send_mdns; document in the MdnBackend trait doc that callers guarantee for_email_id is Some.
title: Dead for_email_id None check in MemoryBackend send_mdns
